programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: 10 year-old Marbles witness the murder of a young woman.

programme.title: God Of Gamblers 2
programme.desc: Multi talented Cho wants to learn from the God of Gamblers and contacts his disciple. They are attacked by a crime boss with a plan to misuse GoG's good name to make millions.

programme.title: Mother Vs Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou.

programme.title: The Mask Of Shura Of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: The Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil.

programme.title: Love On Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move Invincible Wind and Fire Spin.

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident…

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey 2: Cinderella
programme.desc: The convoluted continuation of the adventures of the time-traveling, now-human Monkey King, who attempts to fulfill his divine destiny.

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter who decides to life in Hong Kong's Kowloon Walled City. He is implicated in the fights and conspiracies. When his friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must save his friend.

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: A frustrated young man afflicted with polio works as a paralegal for a corrupt lawyer. He gets passed onto him the technique for a strange power by a dying man, which turns him into an oil based superhero/villain.

programme.title: The Fate Of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death.

programme.title: The Bare-Footed Kid
programme.desc: A young man arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto.

programme.title: A Man Called Hero
programme.desc: Hero Wah goes to study under Master Pride. When he returns to his parents, he learns that they have been murdered by a band of evil Westerners. After impregnating his wife Jade, he ventures to New York in search of his parents' killers.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: The head of a rich family dies and in his will leaves his fortune to his daughter. His son is enraged and uses a rubbish collector who looks the same as his sister to steal the fortune. The Uncle's son also wants a piece of the fortune and coerces a small time thief into stealing the will for his wild scheme.

programme.title: Kung Fu Jungle
programme.desc: Kung Fu Jungle follows a martial arts instructor who is imprisoned after a fatal accident. When a serial killer begins targeting martial arts masters, he offers his help to the police in exchange for freedom. A deadly game of skill and survival unfolds as he confronts the killer using his mastery of kung fu.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: A poor couple, Shui and Ti, try to make a life on their own. And through both of their hard work, Shui becomes a marketing executive, then his attitude begins to change.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Never Leave

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: An actor tries to convince a lady to play Samantha in an adaptation of the classic TV series, but unbeknownst to him, she really is a witch!

programme.title: Song Of The Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family's massacre years ago. While taking on the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy.

programme.title: Hail The Judge
programme.desc: A judge tries to save a female innocent who's wrongly being accused for murder.

programme.title: Fist Of Legend
programme.desc: When Chen Zhen studies in Japan, he finds several Chinese students missing and accidentally uncovers the Black Dragon Society's conspiracy.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its “Cop Shop Babes” as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat – can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission. But his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Ruthless gangster Guts pulls off a heist of diamonds, then enlists the aid of longtime triad member, Fei, to arrange a buyer for them. But when Guts double crosses the buyer, Fei ends up with the diamonds, wanted by both the cops and Guts.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy about a murdered cop returning from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie (Chow) into avenging his death.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon 2
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau’s Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city’s casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Bad Men Must Bleed
programme.desc: Follows a man as he hunts his brother's gang across the old west to stop their rampage.

programme.title: After We Fell
programme.desc: Just as Tessa makes the biggest decision of her life, everything changes. Revelations about her family, and then Hardin's, throw everything they knew before in doubt and makes their future together more difficult.

programme.title: Beneath Us
programme.desc: The American Dream becomes a nightmare for a group of undocumented day laborers hired by a wealthy couple.

programme.title: Death In Texas
programme.desc: Just out of prison, Billy Walker returns to El Paso to find his mom dying of liver failure but low on the transplant list. However, the border offers other, darker options.

programme.title: The Room
programme.desc: In San Francisco, an amiable banker's seemingly perfect life is turned upside down when his deceitful fiancée embarks on an affair with his best friend.

programme.title: The Housekeeper
programme.desc: A young housekeeper accepts a promising position at the home of a wealthy family, only to realize that someone may hiding a deadly secret. Not knowing who to trust, she must solve the mystery while avoiding impending deadly consequences.

programme.title: The Canyons
programme.desc: When Christian, an LA trust-fund kid with casual ties to Hollywood, learns of a secret affair between Tara and Ryan, he spirals out of control, and his cruel mind games escalate into an act of bloody violence.

programme.title: The Junkyard Dogs
programme.desc: Follows a dog who is a master escape artist, who must team up with his puppy pals to prevent their block from being robbed.

programme.title: Edge Of Fear
programme.desc: After being stabbed in the heart by ruthless home invaders, a man is left for dead. Now weak, outnumbered, and knife sticking from his chest, he attempts to do the impossible: save his wife from these murderers before he bleeds to death.

programme.title: War Pigs
programme.desc: A ragtag unit of misfits known as the War Pigs must go behind enemy lines to exterminate Nazis by any means necessary.

programme.title: Burial Ground Massacre
programme.desc: A group of college students spend a night at an old, eerie manor, only to realize that a terrifying stalker is watching their every move as he begins plans to repossess an ancient Native American artifact located inside.

programme.title: Elizabeth Harvest
programme.desc: Elizabeth arrives with her brilliant scientist husband Henry to his magnificent estate. Henry explains that everything in his world now belongs to her, all except for a locked-off room he forbids her from entering.

programme.title: In Isolation
programme.desc: Four friends wanted to get away in a remote country house but when a mysterious man turns up and telling tales of a city ravaged by a epidemic and the looters who have pursued him, the friends rally to help.

programme.title: Shock And Awe
programme.desc: A group of journalists of the Knight-Ridder covering President George W. Bush's planned invasion of Iraq in 2003 are skeptical of the President's claim that Saddam Hussein has 'weapons of mass destruction.'

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Guns
programme.desc: In the lawless West, a notorious brotherhood of killers and thieves called The Cowboys reigns over the land with brutal fists and fast guns. Fate finally catches up with them.

programme.title: The Devil's Trap
programme.desc: A priest travels to investigate a miller suspected to be working with the devil.

programme.title: Safer At Home
programme.desc: Two years into the pandemic, a group of friends throw a wild online party. After taking ecstasy, things go terribly wrong and the safety of their homes becomes more terrifying than the raging chaos outside.

programme.title: You're Not Alone
programme.desc: An evil entity begins to torment a mother and daughter, who are forced to face the inexplicable presence that inhabits the walls of their new home.

programme.title: Radioflash
programme.desc: When a nuclear device causes an electromagnetic pulse that kills power to more than 200 million people, a teenage girl must help lead her family to survival in a dark new world.

programme.title: Intruder
programme.desc: During one of Oregon's most violent storms, a young cellist seeks solitude and comfort in the safety of her large apartment, but soon realizes she might not be home alone.

programme.title: Force Of Execution
programme.desc: A crime boss who runs a southwestern town needs the help of his former hit-man to deal with a new threat to his empire.

programme.title: Bad Men Must Bleed
